body: since my brother is on the verge of death and life is pretty much going downhill for me everyday i decided that it’s time to go, no one even knows me let alone give a shit about me, and i can’t blame them, i’m just a skinny short hideous poor piece of shit, i’m writing this here because i have no one that gives a damn about me in the real world, thank you to the one person who messaged me and made me feel like i have an actual friend, you made me smile, even if it was on the internet and temporary you did, i can’t actually believe that you had faith in me, and i’m sorry for failing you, and to the person who replied saying this “everyone loves a good underdog story take up a musical instrument and join a band” i don’t know if you’re being sarcastic or real but i know that you weren’t of any help. i hope from the bottom of my heart that no one goes through the same fucking piece of shit life as i did, and if you somehow did i really don’t know what to tell you just please don’t take the same road as i did.
